{{Quote|Did you find what you were looking for?''"<br />"''I think so.''"<br />"''And does that make you a Jedi, now?''"<br />"''I don't think so. This was just a step.|Gerant and Torva|<ref name="NoP" />}}
'''Gerant''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] who accompanied [[Torva/Legends|Torva]] on her path to become a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
A [[Gender/Legends|male]], Gerant was acquainted with a woman named [[Torva/Legends|Torva]] and traveled with her to a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with a [[Vergence/Legends|Force nexus]] within a mountain peak. As she entered the cave alone, Gerant remained without where he perched himself on top of a boulder. When Torva exited the cave, she proclaimed to have successfully moved closer to becoming a Jedi.<ref name="NoP" />
